senses.gloss:
ind.
1 Useless, fruitless.
2 Wrong, incorrect.
3 In vain.
4 Compounded with articles of food, it implies they are hot.
E.
वृ to choose, &c., aff. थाक्.

f. (-था)
Idle talk.
E.
वृथा, and कथा speech.

m. (-तः)
Striking or killing any being unnecessarily.
E.
वृथा, and आघात a blow.

f. (-त्टा)
Going about or travelling for pleasure.
E.
वृथा, and अट्या roaming.

n. (-नं)
Unprofitable donation, gift to encomiasts, harlots, wrestlers, money lost at play, &c.
E.
वृथा vain, and दान giving.

m. (-घ्नः)
The slayer of an animal except for sacrifice.
E.
वृथा, and पशु an animal, घ्न who kills.

m. (-म्भः)
Cutting or plucking unnecessarily.
E.
वृथा, and लभि to get, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Born or produced in vain.
E.
वृथा, and उत्यन्न produced.
